# Game Idea: Space Miner

- Top‑down HTML canvas where the player pilots a ship through an asteroid field.
- Use arrow keys (or WASD) to steer and space to fire a mining laser at drifting asteroids.
- Mining yields minerals and a small fuel boost, while fuel continuously drains.
- **Lose condition:** fuel reaches 0 or the ship collides with an asteroid.
- Goal: collect a target amount of minerals before losing.

1: // Simple Space Miner game with enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas with id "game"
3: (function(){
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
7:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
8:   let audioInitialized = false;
9:   function initAudio(){
10:     if(audioInitialized) return;
11:     // resume audio context on user gesture
12:     if(audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
13:     audioInitialized = true;
14:   }
15:   function playLaser(){
16:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
17:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
18:     osc.frequency.value = 660; // laser pitch
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
21:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
22:     osc.start();
23:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
24:   }
25:   function playExplosion(){
26:     const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.3;
27:     const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
28:     const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
29:     for(let i=0;i<bufferSize;i++){
30:       data[i] = (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.pow(1 - i/bufferSize, 2);
31:     }
32:     const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
33:     noise.buffer = buffer;
34:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
35:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
37:     noise.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
38:     noise.start();
39:     noise.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
40:   }
41:   if(!canvas){ console.error('Canvas #game not found'); return; }
42:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
43:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
44:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
45: 
46:   // Game state
47:   const state = {
48:   particles:[], // explosion particles
49: 
50:     ship:{x:width/2,y:height/2,angle:0,rad:12},
51:     fuel:100,
52:     minerals:0,
53:     target:50,
54:     laser:{active:false, x:0,y:0,dx:0,dy:0, life:0},
55:     asteroids:[],
56:     keys:{ArrowUp:false,ArrowDown:false,ArrowLeft:false,ArrowRight:false,KeyW:false,KeyS:false,KeyA:false,KeyD:false,Space:false}
57:   };
58: 
59:   // Helper functions
60:   function rand(min,max){return Math.random()*(max-min)+min;}
61:   function spawnAsteroid(){
62:     const r = rand(10,25);
63:     const angle = rand(0,Math.PI*2);
64:     const speed = rand(0.5,1.5);
65:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0,4)); // 0 top,1 right,2 bottom,3 left
66:     let x,y,dx,dy;
67:     if(side===0){x=rand(0,width); y=-r;}
68:     else if(side===1){x=width+r; y=rand(0,height);} 
69:     else if(side===2){x=rand(0,width); y=height+r;}
70:     else {x=-r; y=rand(0,height);}    
71:     dx = Math.cos(angle)*speed;
72:     dy = Math.sin(angle)*speed;
73:     state.asteroids.push({x,y,dx,dy,r});
74:   }
75:   for(let i=0;i<8;i++) spawnAsteroid();
76: 
77:   // Input handling
78:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{initAudio(); state.keys[e.code]=true;});
79:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{state.keys[e.code]=false;});
80: 
81:   function update(dt){
82:     // Fuel drain
83:     state.fuel = Math.max(0, state.fuel - dt*0.02);
84:     // Ship control
85:     const turnSpeed = 0.004*dt;
86:     const thrust = 0.05*dt;
87:     if(state.keys.ArrowLeft||state.keys.KeyA) state.ship.angle -= turnSpeed;
88:     if(state.keys.ArrowRight||state.keys.KeyD) state.ship.angle += turnSpeed;
89:     if(state.keys.ArrowUp||state.keys.KeyW){
90:       state.ship.x += Math.cos(state.ship.angle)*thrust;
91:       state.ship.y += Math.sin(state.ship.angle)*thrust;
92:     }
93:     if(state.keys.ArrowDown||state.keys.KeyS){
94:       state.ship.x -= Math.cos(state.ship.angle)*thrust*0.5;
95:       state.ship.y -= Math.sin(state.ship.angle)*thrust*0.5;
96:     }
97:     // Keep ship within bounds (wrap)
98:     if(state.ship.x<0) state.ship.x+=width; if(state.ship.x>width) state.ship.x-=width;
99:     if(state.ship.y<0) state.ship.y+=height; if(state.ship.y>height) state.ship.y-=height;
100: 
101:     // Laser fire
102:     if(state.keys.Space && !state.laser.active){
103:       state.laser.active = true;
104:       state.laser.x = state.ship.x;
105:       state.laser.y = state.ship.y;
106:       const speed = 4;
107:       state.laser.dx = Math.cos(state.ship.angle)*speed;
108:       state.laser.dy = Math.sin(state.ship.angle)*speed;
109:       state.laser.life = 30; // frames
110:       playLaser();
111:     }
112:     // Laser update
113:     if(state.laser.active){
114:       state.laser.x += state.laser.dx;
115:       state.laser.y += state.laser.dy;
116:       state.laser.life--;
117:       if(state.laser.life<=0) state.laser.active = false;
118:     }
119: 
120:     // Asteroid movement
121:     state.asteroids.forEach(a=>{a.x+=a.dx; a.y+=a.dy;});
122:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids and respawn
123:     state.asteroids = state.asteroids.filter(a=>{
124:       const off = a.x<-a.r||a.x>width+a.r||a.y<-a.r||a.y>height+a.r;
125:       if(off) spawnAsteroid();
126:       return !off;
127:     });
128: 
129:     // Collision detection laser‑asteroid
130:     if(state.laser.active){
131:       for(let i=state.asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
132:         const a=state.asteroids[i];
133:         const dx=state.laser.x-a.x, dy=state.laser.y-a.y;
134:         if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (a.r)*(a.r)){
135:           // hit
136:           state.asteroids.splice(i,1);
137:           spawnAsteroid();
138:           state.minerals++;
139:           state.fuel = Math.min(100, state.fuel+5); // small boost
140:             state.laser.active = false;
141:             // create explosion particles
142:             const count = 12;
143:             for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
144:               const angle = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
145:               const speed = Math.random()*2+1;
146:               state.particles.push({
147:                 x:a.x,
148:                 y:a.y,
149:                 vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,
150:                 vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,
151:                 life:30,
152:                 size: Math.random()*2+1,
153:                 color:'orange'
154:               });
155:             }
156:             break;
157:           }
158:         }
159:       }
160:     }
161:     // Ship‑asteroid collision
162:     for(const a of state.asteroids){
163:       const dx=state.ship.x-a.x, dy=state.ship.y-a.y;
164:       if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (a.r+state.ship.rad)*(a.r+state.ship.rad)){
165:         state.fuel = 0; // immediate lose
166:       }
167:     }
168:     // Update particles
169:     state.particles = state.particles.filter(p=>{
170:       p.x += p.vx;
171:       p.y += p.vy;
172:       p.life--;
173:       return p.life > 0;
174:     });
175:     for(const a of state.asteroids){
176:       const dx=state.ship.x-a.x, dy=state.ship.y-a.y;
177:       if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (a.r+state.ship.rad)*(a.r+state.ship.rad)){
178:         state.fuel = 0; // immediate lose
179:       }
180:     }
181:   }
182: 
183:   // Generate starfield once
184: const stars = [];
185: function initStars(count=200){
186:   for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
187:     stars.push({x:Math.random()*width, y:Math.random()*height, r:Math.random()*1.5+0.5});
188:   }
189: }
190: initStars();
191: 
192: function draw(){
193:     // background gradient
194: const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,width,height);
195: bgGrad.addColorStop(0,'#001020');
196: bgGrad.addColorStop(1,'#000');
197: ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
198: ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
199: // draw stars with twinkle
200: stars.forEach(s=>{
201:   const twinkle = 0.5 + Math.random()*0.5; // 0.5-1.0
202:   ctx.globalAlpha = twinkle;
203:   ctx.beginPath();
204:   ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2);
205:   ctx.fill();
206: });
207: ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // reset
208:     // draw ship
209:     // draw ship with glow
210:     ctx.save();
211:     ctx.translate(state.ship.x, state.ship.y);
212:     ctx.rotate(state.ship.angle);
213:     // ship shape
214:     ctx.beginPath();
215:     ctx.moveTo(15,0);
216:     ctx.lineTo(-10,-10);
217:     ctx.lineTo(-10,10);
218:     ctx.closePath();
219:     // glow effect
220:     ctx.shadowColor='cyan';
221:     ctx.shadowBlur=10;
222:     ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
223:     ctx.fill();
224:     ctx.shadowBlur=0; // reset
225:     ctx.restore();
226:     // draw asteroids with gradient shading
227:     state.asteroids.forEach(a=>{
228:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r*0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
229:       grad.addColorStop(0,'#aaa');
230:       grad.addColorStop(1,'#555');
231:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
232:       ctx.beginPath();
233:       ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,a.r,0,Math.PI*2);
234:       ctx.fill();
235:     });
236:     // draw laser
237:     if(state.laser.active){
238:       // laser glow
239:       ctx.save();
240:       ctx.shadowColor='red';
241:       ctx.shadowBlur=8;
242:       ctx.strokeStyle='red';
243:       ctx.lineWidth=3;
244:       ctx.beginPath();
245:       ctx.moveTo(state.laser.x,state.laser.y);
246:       ctx.lineTo(state.laser.x - state.laser.dx*2, state.laser.y - state.laser.dy*2);
247:       ctx.stroke();
248:       ctx.restore();
249:     }
250:     // draw explosion particles
251:     state.particles.forEach(p=>{
252:       ctx.globalAlpha = p.life/30;
253:       ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
254:       ctx.beginPath();
255:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI*2);
256:       ctx.fill();
257:     });
258:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // reset
259:     // UI
260:     ctx.fillStyle='lime';
261:     ctx.font='16px monospace';
262:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: '+Math.floor(state.fuel),10,20);
263:     ctx.fillText('Minerals: '+state.minerals+'/'+state.target,10,40);
264:     if(state.fuel<=0||state.minerals>=state.target){
265:       ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
266:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
267:       ctx.fillStyle='white';
268:       ctx.textAlign='center';
269:       ctx.font='48px sans-serif';
270:       const msg = state.minerals>=state.target ? 'You Win!' : 'Game Over';
271:       ctx.fillText(msg, width/2, height/2);
272:     }
273:   }
274: 
275:   let last=performance.now();
276:   function loop(){
277:     const now=performance.now();
278:     const dt=now-last;
279:     last=now;
280:     if(state.fuel>0 && state.minerals<state.target){
281:       update(dt);
282:     }
283:     draw();
284:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
285:   }
286:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
287: })();
